payload.claim: The module docstring still says this script is 'Not safe beside PACKAGE's re-verification. Its network takes `DEFAULT_SUBNET`, which that re-verification also creates on, so whichever starts second fails at `create_network`.' That was true at the tree base, when reverify's `_gate_cell` called `create_network(network)` with no subnet and so defaulted onto `10.88.0.0/24`. After this diff, `reverify`'s `_gate_cell` claims its two networks with `allocate_network`, which walks `SUBNETS["pool"]` (`10.200.0.0/16`), never `10.88.0.0/24`. This script's own network is still hardcoded to `10.88.0.0/24` (line 60), so the collision this paragraph warns about no longer exists: the two can now run at once with no clash on `create_network`. The spec names three comments this change makes false and asks for each to be rewritten (`saffron/phases/package.py:533-534`, `saffron/cell/session.py:1363-1366`, and the comment above `SUBNETS`); this fourth one, in a file this spec's own `touches` already includes and edits (lines 60-64), was left stale.
